items.title: Wanted: A Strategy Chief to Bring Air India’s Two Airlines Closer
items.why: Air India is creating a strategy role after IndiGo hired a former Air India Express chief as its strategy officer.

items.title: IndiGo Adds Southeast Asia Flights as Westbound Costs Climb
items.why: IndiGo is adding Southeast Asia flights, shifting capacity from routes where costs are rising, though it cut six routes there this summer.
